main_claim: On Joe Rogan's podcast Topuria said he was never a fan of Demetrious Johnson because he mistook the nickname 'Mighty Mouse' for 'Mickey Mouse', and Johnson joked back.
note: He is quoted at length ('I never was a big fan of him... why are you calling yourself the Mickey Mouse?') about another fighter, and the article comes back to him with Johnson's reply ('All Gucci boiiss', joking about a training clinch), so he shares the stage rather than being only mentioned. His words are about his own fandom and his own slip, so I read it as speaks_of_himself, but an editor could call his talk about Johnson none_of_these, or take Johnson's joking clinch reply as other_fighter_side calls_him_out; no fact about him is asserted, so fact is no_fact and the three news questions are no.
